qs.s: Genera in the same family share higher categories like order, class, and phylum.

qs.q: Which of the following plants is a monocotyledon?
qs.s: Wheat is a monocot plant, whereas tobacco, potato, and mango are dicots.

qs.q: Select the correct statement from the following.
o: Worker bee undergoes reproduction to generate new progeny
Mule and worker bees are both fertile
qs.s: Mules and worker bees are sterile, making none of the preceding positive statements correct.

qs.q: Generally growth and reproduction are-
qs.s: In complex multicellular organisms, growth and reproduction are mutually exclusive.

qs.q:
Select the correct match with respect to brinjal:
(I) Family - Solanaceae.
(II) Class - Dicotyledonae.
(III) Genus - Solanum.
(IV) Order - Sapindales.
(V) Species - melongena.
qs.s: Categories I, II, III, and V correctly describe brinjal; order is Polymoniales, not Sapindales.

qs.q: The twin characteristics of growth are
o: Increase in number of individuals, increase in mass
Increase in height and decrease in weight
Increase in weight and increase in mass
Increase in size and decrease in mass
qs.s: Growth has twin characteristics: increase in mass and increase in number of individuals.

qs.q:
Match the following and choose the correct option:
A. Family -> P. tuberosum
B. Kingdom -> Q. Polymoniales
C. Order -> R. Solanum
D. Species -> S. Plantae
E. Genus -> T. Solanaceae
qs.s: Correct pairing maps Family to Solanaceae (T), Kingdom to Plantae (S), Order to Polymoniales (Q), Species to tuberosum (P), Genus to Solanum (R).

qs.q: Linnaeus is credited with
qs.s: Carl Linnaeus formulated and popularized the binomial nomenclature system.

qs.q: All the given options represent the basic process of taxonomy except
qs.s: 'Specification' is not a core taxonomic process; characterization, identification, nomenclature, and classification are.

qs.q: Choose the correct match
o: Order - a group of related division
Genus - a group of related species
Class - a group of related genera
Division - a group of related phyla
qs.s: A genus is correctly defined as a group of related species.

qs.q:
Which of the following are correct statements?
(I) Genus is a group of related species.
(II) Family is a group of related genera.
(III) Class is a group of related orders.
(IV) Order is a higher category than family.
(V) Domain is a group of classes.
qs.s: Statements I, II, III, and IV accurately describe taxonomic definitions and ranks.

qs.q: Which one is the correct form of the scientific name for man
qs.s: Genus capitalized and species lowercase: Homo sapiens.

qs.q: In the taxonomic categories which heirarchial arrangement in ascending order is correct in case of animals?
o: Kingdom, Class, Phylum, Family, Order, Genus, Species
Kingdom, Order, Class, Phylum, Family, Genus, Species
Kingdom, Order, Phylum, Class, Family, Genus, Species
Kingdom, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, Species
qs.s: Ascending order from lowest (species) to highest (kingdom): Species -> Genus -> Family -> Order -> Class -> Phylum -> Kingdom.

qs.q:
Which of the following can be considered as the defining property of living organisms?
i. Consciousness
ii. Growth
iii. Cellular organisation
iv. Metabolism
v. Reproduction
qs.s: Consciousness (i), cellular organization (iii), and metabolism (iv) are defining properties.

qs.q: Individuals of which taxa can interbreed freely?
qs.s: Species members can naturally interbreed and produce fertile offspring.

qs.q: The scientific name of wheat is
qs.s: Correct binomial name for wheat is Triticum aestivum.

qs.q: Binomial nomenclature means writing the name of an organism in two words which designate
qs.s: Binomial nomenclature designates the genus and the species.

qs.q: Which is an exclusive trait of living things
o: Isolated metabolic reactions occur in in vitro
Increase in mass from inside body
Perception of events happening in the environment and their memory
Increase in mass by accumulation of material both on surface as well as internally.
qs.s: Perception of environmental events and memory (consciousness) is an exclusive attribute of life.

qs.q: The term 'systematics' refers to:
o: Identification and study of organ systems
Identification and preservation of plants and animals
Diversity of kinds of organisms and their relationship
Study of habitats of organisms and their classification
qs.s: Systematics focuses on organism diversity and evolutionary relationships.

qs.q: Patient in "COMA" can show
qs.s: Comatose patients maintain metabolism (often machine-aided) but lack self-consciousness/consciousness.

qs.q:

(II) Order - Poales.
(III) Genus - Solanum.
(IV) Class - Dicotyledonae.
(V) Division - Angiospermae.

qs.q: Which of the following is not an universal rule for nomenclature of organisms?
o: New names are derived from Latin or are Latinized
The name, when handwritten, should be separately underlined or printed in italics.
The first word denoting genus should always be in capital letters while species name starts in a small letter.
Each taxonomic group above the rank of species can have more than one correct name.
qs.s: Each taxonomic group can have only one correct valid scientific name.

qs.q: Properties of tissues are not present in the constituent cells but arise as a result of interaction among cells.
qs.s: Tissue properties emerge due to interactions among constituent cells.

qs.q: The highest taxon in taxonomic hierarchy is
qs.s: Kingdom is the highest rank in the taxonomic hierarchy.

qs.q: A human being and a cow can be differentiated in the following defined feature
qs.s: Self-consciousness differentiates humans from other animals like cows.

qs.q:

I. Kingdom -> division -> class -> order -> genus -> family -> species
II. Kingdom -> division -> order -> class -> family -> species
III. Kingdom -> species -> order -> class -> family (Descending order)

qs.q: Specific epithet is
o: First word in the scientific name of a species
Second word in the scientific name of a species
qs.s: The specific epithet is always the second word in a binomial scientific name.

qs.q: The housefly belongs to which order in taxonomical classification?
qs.s: Housefly belongs to order Diptera.

qs.q: What is the utility of hierarchical taxonomic system?
o: As each higher taxonomic category contains groups/categories below it
It is helpful to establish classification
qs.s: The hierarchical system facilitates organization, classification, and identification.

qs.q: Which of the following statements is correct for families in taxonomy
o: Animal families ends with suffix - idea
A family is a group of related genera with less number of similarities as compared to genus and species.
Both vegetative and reproduction features are taken as the basis of plant classification
qs.s: All stated statements regarding taxonomic families are correct.

qs.q: A taxon is a
qs.s: A taxon represents any unit or group in biological classification regardless of its rank.
